meeting_summary: The meeting started with a painting exercise to familiarize participants with drawing tools. Then, the team discussed their experiences with existing remote controls, highlighting issues like difficulty of use, breakage on dropping, and too many small buttons. They brainstormed design requirements for a new remote control, including being original/trendy/user-friendly, a selling price of 25 Euros with a 12.50 Euro manufacturing budget, lightweight, few and large buttons, drop resistance, an LED for feedback, low-cost plastic material, visual attractiveness, compatibility with existing products, and low battery consumption. No specific actions or unresolved questions were recorded.
